title: Let material feed creation
description: Choose an embedding model and connect the material library so indexed data can feed analysis, planning and writing.

understanding.title: Choose how material is understood
understanding.description: Use a configured, available provider; the model only understands the material's meaning and doesn't edit the source.

fields.clearQdrantKey: Clear the saved vector store API key on save

model.remoteHint: Use a suggested model first; once the connection works, the provider's model list appears here.
model.customHint: Choose a model above or enter a custom model name.

placeholders.keepKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key
placeholders.embeddingKey: Enter the embedding service API key
placeholders.defaultUrl: Leave blank to use the provider's default URL
placeholders.qdrantKey: Enter the vector store API key

advanced.title: Advanced configuration
advanced.description: Collection version v{{version}} · collection name, indexing, retrieval quality and background task parameters

collection.title: Collection & index
collection.description: The name auto-distinguishes collections by provider, model, tag and version to reduce vector-dimension conflict risk.
collection.tagHint: Use a short tag to distinguish environments or data groups.
collection.name: Vector collection name
collection.autoReindex: Auto re-index when the embedding changes

hints.qdrantUrl: The local address is usually http://127.0.0.1:6333; for cloud, enter the full URL.

parameterHints.general: Defaults suit most libraries; adjust only when the connection is slow, batch writes fail, or you need to pause retrieval.
parameterHints.upsertConcurrency: Max concurrent chunk batches sent to Qdrant. Default 3; raise to 4-6 for large documents to speed up.
parameterHints.retrieval: When retrieval isn't precise enough or you need to control latency, adjust chunking and candidate counts.
parameterHints.embedding: For bulk import or slow service responses, adjust batch size, timeout, retry count and polling parameters.
parameterHints.embeddingConcurrency: Concurrent embedding API requests. Default 4; raising it can noticeably cut large-document indexing time but must respect provider quotas.
parameterHints.save: After saving, newly created or re-indexed material uses this retrieval configuration.

embeddingConnectionHint: This connection is only for understanding material; it doesn't change the creation model, default model or task routing.

database.title: Connect the material library
database.description: Supports Qdrant Cloud, self-hosted Qdrant or a local material library.
